scene.summary: A walled courtyard. A lit lantern hangs beside the gate. A side gate is barred from the other side. Warden Rell watches the road.
visible_facts: A soot-streaked lantern burns beside the courtyard gate.
The side gate is barred from the other side.
Warden Rell looks concerned as she watches the road.
